497:t_111:3.en:
$$ロックオン$$
「Here we go! $$ロックオン$$, $$ガンダムサバーニャ$$, firing at will!!」

497:t_112:0.en:
$$ピーリス$$
「Incredible...! This mobility... it's on a whole other level!」

497:t_112:1.en:
$$アレルヤ$$
「Let's go, $$マリー$$! We'll draw out the full power of the $$ハルート$$ together!」

497:t_112:2.en:
$$ハレルヤ$$
(Hold it, $$アレルヤ$$. That 'we' includes me, right?)

497:t_112:3.en:
$$アレルヤ$$
「Of course it does, $$ハレルヤ$$.」

497:t_112:4.en:
$$ハレルヤ$$
(Hearing that, I can't stay quiet! Let's do it, $$アレルヤ$$!)

497:t_112:5.en:
$$アレルヤ$$
「Yeah! We'll fight alongside the $$ハルート$$ with the power of a true super soldier!」

497:t_113:0.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「The GN Big Cannon's output is rising...! With this, we can do it!」

497:t_113:1.en:
$$ティエリア$$
(I will fight...! Until the day I fulfill my mission!)

497:t_114:0.en:
$$デュオ$$
「Thanks, old man $$イアン$$! It's a sweet piece of work!」

497:t_114:1.en:
$$デュオ$$
「Let's go, partner! We'll wake up the guys who keep the war going forever!」

497:t_115:0.en:
$$トロワ$$
「This upgrade is a rare chance. I'll make use of that power.」

497:t_115:1.en:
$$トロワ$$
「To end this war as soon as possible.」

497:t_116:0.en:
$$カトル$$
「$$サンドロック$$... With your upgraded power, I will end this war...!」

497:t_116:1.en:
$$カトル$$
「The universe longs for peace...! Beyond that, there must be the Heart of Space!」

497:t_117:0.en:
$$五飛$$
「$$ナタク$$! With your new power, I will uphold my justice!」

497:t_117:1.en:
$$五飛$$
「The eyes of the twin dragon are set on the future! They will lead the world!」

497:t_118:0.en:
$$ゼクス$$
(My friend $$トレーズ$$... The $$トールギス$$ you left behind is still with me even now...)

497:t_118:1.en:
$$ゼクス$$
「With that white, gallant form, I will race through space! As the wind that snuffs out the flames of war!」

497:t_119:0.en:
$$コーラサワー$$
「I'll master it, $$トランザム$$! To end this war!」

497:t_119:1.en:
$$コーラサワー$$
「And then the Colonel will praise me! 'Well done, $$パトリック$$'... just like that!」

497:t_120:0.en:
$$グラハム$$
「I'm grateful, $$カタギリ$$! I will surely draw out the power of this $$ブレイヴ$$ that you finished for me!」

497:t_120:1.en:
$$グラハム$$
「And I will keep fighting until the day of victory! That is my duty!」
